The main takeaway from our work is that
in characteristic $p>2$ there is a new phenomenon: ${\rm Ver}^+_{p^n}\subset{\rm Ver}_{p}$ is not the full subcategory of $p$-nilpotent modules, and the latter does not admit fiber functors.

${\rm char}(k)$-points of the moduli spaces of representations of quantum groups, which are the analog of the Deligne category Rep$(\mathbb{S})$ for quantum groups, are given by categories of the form ${\rm Ver}^+_{p^n}$.
, unlike in characteristic zero, there are no known obstructions to the existence of fiber functors to the categories ${\rm Ver}^+_{p^n}$.
